thread:
maria: Quick sync — aiming to announce the release tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog snippet, docs URL, and inbound routing for leads. Who's got what?
toni: I can finalize the changelog summary. Will include breaking changes and the model compatibility table.
ben: Deploy plan draft ready. Prefer a 2-stage rollout: canary -> 40% -> 100% over 90 minutes.
sasha: Docs PR in flight, review required. ETA 3pm PT for merge. I'll post the canonical link here when done.
priya: Webinar confirmed 11am PT (recording enabled). I'll push slides + registration link by EOD. Need the short demo script from eng.
alec: QA: please make sure the benchmark page includes p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec for both old and new routing. I'll run one last smoke run pre-release.
ben: Rollout plan snippet:
```
- 09:00 PT canary (5% traffic)
- 09:20 PT ramp to 40%
- 09:50 PT full 100%
- monitor: 4xx/5xx, p95 latency, error budget; auto-pause if p95 > 2x baseline or error rate > 0.5%
- alert channels: eng-oncall + marketing-notify
```
maria: Marketing needs a fallback customer message in case we pause. Short CTA + status link.
sasha: Fallback blurb: "We're rolling out improvements; a small percentage of users may see temporary slowdowns — we're rolling back to keep your experience uninterrupted. Status & updates: <status link>"
priya: Inbound routing plan: utm_source=announce -> webhook to SDR intake -> Salesforce queue: "announce_inbound" -> auto-tag: feature_interest, webinar_registrant. Send instant ack email and follow-up nurture at +24h.
a: (typo)
alec: Also please attach the SDR playbook (objections, benchmark highlights, top use-cases) to the Notion page.
ben: Deploy bot setup: monitoring hooks + canary traffic rules queued. I'll add the rollback window to the runbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment job created: job_id=deploy-20260324-09-00, canary scheduled at 5074202468. Health checks: enabled.
qa-bot: Smoke tests scheduled at T+10m and T+30m post-canary. Will report pass/fail into the thread.
toni: Changelog snippets:
- short: "Smarter batching and latency-aware routing — lower cost & faster responses. Docs + benchmarks: <docs link>"
- long: "This release adds adaptive batching, multi-tier model routing, and Optimize dashboard updates. See full changelog (models, migration notes, benchmarks): <changelog link>"
maria: Thanks. Two final asks: 1) Sasha paste the docs URL once merged; 2) Priya paste the webhook mapping and the Notion SDR playbook link.
sasha: Docs live: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-24-routing-batching
priya: Webhook mapping sent to #support: https://hooks.redwood.ai/ingest/announce (fields: email, utm_source, demo_interest, org_size). Notion playbook: https://notion.redwood.ai/SDR/announce-playbook
alec: Benchmarks uploaded: https://benchmarks.redwood.ai/2026-03-batching-routing (p50/p95 + token cost delta). Smoke run green locally.
ben: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/release-2026-03-24-rollout 
maria: Perfect. Marketing will draft the tweet thread + blog and post package here at 17:30 for final sign-off. Monitoring windows: marketing will watch engagement first 2 hours. Eng will watch health for 60 minutes after full rollout.

toni: Draft blog intro added to Notion, includes benchmark narrative + customer impact section.
priya: SDR follow-up templates ready in Notion, will trigger on webhook.
